messages.content: Write a Python function `slugify(title: str) -> str` in src/utils/text.py. Requirements: lowercase, spaces and underscores become hyphens, strip non-alphanumerics, collapse repeated hyphens, max 80 chars. Output only the function with a docstring, no prose. Example: slugify('Hello_World! 2x') == 'hello-world-2x'. Constraint: stdlib only, because this module must stay dependency-free.
